summary_ja: 内部モデル方式のリスク・ファクターが満たすべき要件(時価評価に用いる全リスク・ファクター、各リスク・クラスごとの特定方法等)を定める。
summary_en: Sets the requirements for risk factors under the internal model approach, including coverage of valuation risk factors and class-specific rules for interest rate, credit spread, foreign exchange, equity, commodity and fund investment risk.

sections_en.第二節 第二款: Requirements for the Internal Model Approach

paragraphs: The risk factors of the internal model approach shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (i) All risk factors used for valuation are included. In this case, where such a risk factor is not included in the trading desk's risk management model, the reason shall be indicated. (ii) Risk factors relating to the risk classes corresponding to the standardized method prescribed in the following Section (excluding risk factors relating to securitization products prescribed in Article 261, paragraphs (3) and (4)) are included. In this case, where such a risk factor is not included in the internal model approach, the reason shall be indicated. (iii) Expected shortfall, expected shortfall assuming market turmoil and stressed expected shortfall include the non-linear risk, correlation risk and related basis risk of options and other related instruments. (iv) Where proxies are used because it is difficult to obtain market data on a risk factor, the reasonableness of using the proxy shall be shown. (v) The risk factors relating to general interest rate risk under the internal model approach satisfy all of the following requirements. (a) The trading desk's risk management model models the yield curve using a generally used method. (b) The yield curve sets multiple maturities and includes the volatility of interest rates along the yield curve corresponding to those maturities. (c) For material exposures to interest rate movements in major currencies and major markets, the yield curve is modelled using at least six risk factors. (d) The number of risk factors used is determined taking into account the trading policy. (vi) The risk factors for credit spread risk are identified on the premise that they include risk factors for capturing credit spread risk separated from general interest rate risk. (vii) With respect to foreign exchange risk under the internal model approach, risk factors satisfying all of the following requirements are identified. (a) They include a risk factor corresponding to each foreign currency in which positions are denominated. (b) They include risk factors for the reporting currency and for exchange rates with respect to which there are material exposures. (viii) With respect to equity risk under the internal model approach, risk factors corresponding to equity markets in which the company holds material positions are identified by any of the following methods. In this case, the concentration of positions in individual stocks within the equity market as a whole or within a sector of the equity market shall be taken into account. (a) A method using a risk factor that reflects movements in stock prices across the equity market as a whole (including a method of expressing positions in individual stocks or industry indices by a beta-converted amount relative to the market-wide index). (b) A method using a risk factor corresponding to a sector of the equity market (including a method of expressing positions in individual stocks belonging to each sector by a beta-converted amount relative to the index of that sector). (c) A method using a risk factor corresponding to the volatility of individual stocks. (ix) With respect to commodity risk under the internal model approach, risk factors corresponding to commodity products in which the company holds material positions are identified by the method prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the category of case listed in (a) or (b). (a) Where product positions with commodities as the underlying asset are limited: a method of identifying risk factors using a simplified approach (including a method using one risk factor for each commodity price and a method of substituting risk factors of commodities with different delivery locations). (b) Where commodity transactions are actively conducted: a method that takes into account changes in convenience yield (meaning the rate reflecting the benefits and costs of directly holding the physical commodity) between derivative positions and physical commodity positions. (x) With respect to the risk relating to investments in funds under the internal model approach, risk factors are identified by the method prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the category of case listed in (a) or (b). (a) Where look-through is possible for an investment in a fund classified in the trading book: a method of identifying the risks of the individual positions constituting the fund (limited to a method in which those positions are assigned to the trading desk to which the fund has been assigned). (b) Where look-through is not possible for an investment in a fund classified in the trading book, and the daily price and the investment mandate or information on the market risk equivalent amount of the fund has been obtained: a method of using the standardized method to calculate the market risk equivalent amount of the fund.
